subject: Post-call recap and buying-process questions — BrightArc decision criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@brightarc.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 16:02:00 -0500
Subject: Post-call recap and questions — BrightArc decision criteria

Hi Elena — thanks again for the 30m demo / discovery earlier. Quick recap and the few items we need to map to move to a short pilot: 

What we heard from your side (please correct):
- Primary use: real-time triage for clinical intake and routing (short prompts, high QPS spikes during business hours)
- Decision timeline: target evaluation & procurement by end of Q1
- Key decision criteria:
  * Latency (p95 goal) — you mentioned 200ms as an ideal upper bound
  * Unit cost sensitivity — target to keep per-call inference costs comparable to current vendor (approx $0.0015–$0.003/token equivalent metric)
  * Deployment mode — preference for Dedicated capacity vs fully hosted with VPC?
  * Security/compliance — SOC 2 Type II and data residency in US required

Open asks for you / your team:
1) Confirm the economic buyer and final procurement contact (we need contact for PO/licensing approval).
2) Confirm whether Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) or Private (VPC/on-prem) is the preferred final deployment for contractual SLA. If undecided, tell us who will sign off on that choice (infrastructure/CTO/procurement).
3) Finalize the hard targets for latency (p50/p95), monthly token volume estimate for pricing, and any SLA specifics (uptime, incident windows).

Next steps from Redwood:
- I'll circulate a one-page technical summary and a mutual action plan (attached) and loop in Jonas (solutions) + Lauren (post-sales) for pilot scoping.
- If you can share the procurement timeline and economic buyer contact, we’ll prepare a tailored proposal and an estimated cost model.

Attachments: brightarc_map_v1.xlsx (MAP draft) and redwood_technical_one-pager.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on a short follow-up with procurement/security as needed.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0122

- Economic buyer: Anil Kapoor (CTO) — I've cc'd him. He handles platform vendor approvals.
- Procurement contact: procurement@brightarc.com (Sally is our procurement lead, inbox above).
- Deployment preference: our platform/security team prefers Dedicated capacity for predictable performance, but final decision may consider cost delta between Dedicated and a VPC-hosted private option.
- Latency: p95 target is 200ms during steady-state; spiky windows acceptable to 400ms if we can get robust autoscaling (we need p50/p95 in any SLA language).
- Cost target: not a hard per-token number yet — procurement will push for blended TCO better than our current vendor; please provide a model for 3 traffic tiers (low/expected/peak).
- Security: SOC 2 Type II is required. We also need clarity on data retention, KMS options, and audit log access for evidence during vendor review.

Procurement timeline: procurement will start vendor evaluations in January; approval and PO expected by end of Q1 if evaluation is successful.

Can you add Jonas and Lauren to scope the pilot and send any security artifacts you have now (SOC 2 summary, data residency statements)?

Best,
Elena

Hi Elena / team — thanks for the context. High-level proposal inline and attached benchmark_plan.md: 

Short pilot (2 weeks) objectives:
- Validate p95 latency <= 200ms under expected QPS (we'll test steady-state and a 3x traffic spike).
- Measure per-request token-equivalent cost across three traffic tiers and project monthly spend.
- Confirm autoscaling behavior and cold-start characteristics for Dedicated pools.

Test plan (summary):
- Week 1: Synthetic replay of representative prompts (we'll ask BrightArc for a 2k sample set) at expected QPS to collect p50/p95/p99 charts.
- Week 2: Spike tests (3x expected QPS for 30-minute windows) + endurance run (8 hours steady).

Deliverables:
- Latency & throughput dashboard snapshot, cost model CSV, short runbook for pilot handoff to CS.
- SOC2 summary & KMS options doc (we'll include the SOC2 report extract and KMS integration notes).

Cost model notes: for Dedicated we show a committed monthly rate + usage; hosted/VPC pricing will be presented side-by-side. For modeling we need an estimate of average tokens per call and monthly call volume — Marissa, Elena, can you confirm the expected monthly calls for the pilot and an average token count per call?

Attachment: benchmark_plan.md

Happy to run a 30-minute technical kickoff next week with your infra/security folks (Anil?).

- Jonas
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
